title: Tracker upkeep, assembled
sub: The model reads the inbox and proposes; code compares every field against the source that owns it; a person approves anything that overwrites a person's work.

nodes.l: Check what each source is current to
Read each unread message, one call each
Drop any proposal the message does not say
Compare every field against the source that owns it
Report what nobody confirmed this week
The approval queue, with both values side by side
A person approves, and the document changes

steps.h: The timer fires: nothing decided anything
steps.d:
The same day every week. A tracker that is only updated
when somebody remembers is a tracker nobody trusts,
which is the whole reason this runs on a schedule

steps.h: Your code asks each source what it is current to
steps.d:
The tracker export and the inbox both moved to 09/18/2026
The time spreadsheet still says 09/15/2026, the same date the
last run saw, so nothing it feeds was confirmed this week
steps.m: no model call: two date comparisons

steps.d:
3 messages, 3 calls, each returning zero or more proposed
field changes with the sentence each came from
One message says nothing and proposes nothing, correctly

steps.h: Your code throws away what the message does not say
steps.d:
A proposal whose quote is not in the message it came from is
dropped and named. So is one naming a project no row covers,
a field the tracker does not have, or a value already there

steps.h: Your code compares field by field
steps.d:
21 cells, each against the source that owns it
A value that matches is confirmed and dated; a value that
differs goes to one of the two piles below
steps.m: no model call: this is the level-0 half

steps.d:
2 fields updated, both written by code and disagreed with by
the system of record
4 queued, 19 cells left exactly as they were
steps.m: nothing the model returned was applied

steps.h: Your code reports what nobody confirmed
steps.d:
1 source not refreshed since the last run
1 project the export stopped listing, which is not the same
as finished
6 fields now aging, with how long and why
steps.m: absence is reported, never read as agreement

steps.h: A person approves what overwrites a person's work
steps.d:
Each queued change shows the old value, the new one, the
reason, and the sentence it was read out of
Approving two changes to one cell is refused, not resolved
